messages:
maya: quick thought — UX issue: when we route to a fallback model due to quota/capacity we just return 200 and no visual hint in the console. customers see degraded outputs and think it's a model quality problem.

sam: +1. need a consistent client-visible signal. two parts: API contract (headers/body) and console badge/tooltip.

leo: proposal: add response header `x-redwood-fallback: 1` and `x-redwood-fallback-reason: capacity_shortage` and keep status 200. also include a `fallback` block in the response JSON so SDKs can surface it.

anne: prefer header + body to avoid breaking clients. fallback != error, so don't change HTTP status codes.

sam: also propose `x-redwood-quota-badge: transient` when quota causes routing to lower-tier model; that lets the console show a badge without parsing body.

maya: console copy drafts:
- Badge label: "Fallback — model downgraded"
- Tooltip: "This request was routed to an alternate model due to temporary capacity or quota limits. Results may vary."

sam: telemetry: emit `event=fallback_exposed` with fields {model_from, model_to, reason, plan_tier} and sample at 100% for first 48h then 10% thereafter. include `client_visible=true` when header is present.

leo: sample response snippet for SDKs to parse:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
x-redwood-fallback: 1
x-redwood-fallback-reason: capacity_shortage
x-redwood-quota-badge: transient
{
  "id": "resp_...",
  "model": "gpt-4o-mini",
  "fallback": {
    "to_model": "gpt-4o-mini-small",
    "reason": "capacity_shortage",
    "recommended_action": "retry_with_backoff_or_upgrade",
    "user_message": "Request routed to alternate model due to temporary capacity."
  }
}
```

anne: small UX note: badge tooltip should call out SLA implications, e.g. "May not meet latency or quality SLOs" so product teams can triage easily.

maya: action items: (1) eng-platform add headers + body contract and SDK exposure; (2) console implement yellow badge + tooltip and copy variants; (3) infra add telemetry event + sampling rules; (4) docs update (API reference + migration notes).

sam: I'll own the SDK changes. pinging infra-bot to create an RFC/ticket.

infra-bot: created RFC #R-453: 'client-visible-fallbacks' assigned to sam, due 2025-01-15.

leo: thanks — let's also add a small e2e test that simulates capacity_shortage and verifies headers + console badge render.

maya: good call. We'll review RFC in eng-platform sync next week. :+1:
